family: GTK2 KDE palette bridge and generated pixmap refresh

change.summary: Verified the existing GTK2 palette bridge. The active DomainOS GTK2 companion path calls setup/refresh; the runtime reads KDE exported GTK color roles, produces content-addressed pixmap bundles and updates owned GTK2 RC wrappers transactionally.

validation.command: env TMPDIR=$HOME/tempia PYTHONPATH=tools:tests python3 -m unittest test_gtk2_palette_runtime
cases: three palette values refreshed actual pixmap files while preserving canonical art
restore recovered original wrapper bytes and modes
refresh was idempotent for unchanged colors
edited or unsafe theme resources were refused
transaction failure and concurrent color changes were guarded
validation.isolation: Synthetic XDG roots under temporary test fixtures; TMPDIR pointed to ~/tempia. Personal profile, XChat and MAME were not modified.

limits: This test verifies runtime generation/transaction semantics, not live KDE schema-change notification or GTK2 application redraw in the user session.
Does not establish historical SR10.4 fidelity of every GTK2 control.
The MAME channel still contains an uncorrelated screenshot request whose path belongs to another item; no new VM command was sent.
next: Continue the authorized GTK2 audit with current palette roles and one control family at a time. Obtain the matching VM evidence only when the existing MAME request is resolved; do not apply to the user profile or XChat while I167 remains partial.
